name: XCC_CB_OVERRIDE_COMPILED
description: This table contains compiled override information, in a format that is easier to use by the budgetary control engine.

columns.name: TRANSACTION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Transaction type for which the override rule applies. Contains a single space if it applies to all transaction types.

columns.name: JE_SOURCE_CODE
columns.description: Journal source for which the override rule applies. Contains a single space if it applies for all journal sources.

columns.name: JE_CATEGORY_CODE
columns.description: Journal category for which the override rule applies. Contains a single space if it applies to all journal categories.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_AMOUNT
columns.description: Amount that the override rule can override distributions by. This amount is available in the budget currency.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_CLOSED_PERIOD_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the override rule enables overriding closed periods.

columns.name: OVERRIDE_RULE_ID
columns.description: Override rule from which this compiled row was generated.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
